name: The Lost Food Project
summary: Rescues good surplus food before it goes to landfill and delivers it to charities and low-income families.
programmes: Surplus food rescue from retailers and suppliers
Distribution to charity partners and urban poor families
Bread rescue and produce sorting with volunteers
Outreach and education on food waste
impact: 2.9 million kg of food rescued, about 8.5 million meals, in 2025 (NST, June 2026)
Over 11 million kg rescued and 33 million meals delivered from 2016 to January 2026 (NST, June 2026)
beneficiaries: Charity partners and low-income urban families, mainly in the Klang Valley

organisation.founders: Suzanne Mooney MBE, who moved to Malaysia in 2014 and started the project after charity work showed her the need for food
organisation.leadership: Geoff King (President); Sarah Grasset (Vice President); Nadiah Hanim Abdul Latif (Secretary); Seow Pek Chin (Treasurer)
